parsed.rationale: All three records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature`, meaning they are local SwiftUI `ContentView` type aliases — a ubiquitous SwiftUI convention where each module defines its own entry-point view under that name. The three live in entirely unrelated packages (`WXUI`, `MusicShareKit`, and `app:WXYC TV`) and files (`WXUISampleApp.swift`, `RequestSentHUD.swift`, `ContentView.swift`), with no shared structural evidence (all `jaccard`, `shared_field_count`, and `shared_ancestor` fields are null). The name collision is purely coincidental and idiomatic; merging or renaming these would break SwiftUI preview and entry-point conventions in each package.
